title: sonchus longifolius
intro: Sonchus longifolius, commonly known as Rough Sow Thistle or Long-leaf Sow Thistle, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate digestive issues and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Sonchus longifolius include its potential to inhibit the growth of cancer cells, reduce fever, and act as a diuretic. The bioactive constituents of Sonchus longifolius include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
